_about: Scholarships Nepali self-funded master's students can actually get, read from each university's own pages (checked 4–5 Oct 2026). kind: nepal = only for Nepal; auto = given automatically to eligible international students; grade = automatic if you reach the UK grade in `min`; apply = you must apply and awards are competitive; early = discount for paying the deposit or fees early; pathway = only via the university's pathway/pre-master's college; partner = only if your bachelor's is from a listed partner institution. amt is the £ value used for cost totals (only nepal/auto/grade awards count towards the 'sure scholarship'). courses limits an award to listed programmes.

University of Exeter.name: PGT Scholarship for Nepal
University of Exeter.note: Automatic for Nepali citizens on an eligible master's (January 2027 list includes MSc Computer Science, Data Science and Advanced Data Science — not Advanced Computer Science). Must meet offer conditions and pay the deposit. Can combine with Exeter Excellence up to £10,000.

University of Exeter.name: Exeter Excellence Scholarship
University of Exeter.note: Competitive, for high-achieving offer holders; apply after getting an offer (January 2027 applications under the 2026/27 scheme until 26 Nov 2026).

Swansea University.name: Nepal and Sri Lanka Thrive Bursary
Swansea University.note: Automatic for students from Nepal — but offered by The College, Swansea University (the pathway / pre-master's college), not for direct MSc entry.

Birmingham City University.name: International Postgraduate Scholarship
Birmingham City University.note: For self-funded international students on a full-time taught master's (listed on BCU's Nepal page).

Coventry University.name: Coventry University Group Scholarship
Coventry University.note: All self-funded international (non-EU) students on full-time taught degrees at UK campuses; no application, but the full CAS deposit must be cleared by the date in your offer.

Edge Hill University.name: Global Vice-Chancellor's Award
Edge Hill University.note: Automatic for international fee-paying students; shown on your offer letter.

Edge Hill University.name: Early payment discount
Edge Hill University.note: Pay full tuition fees before your CAS is issued.

University of Lincoln.name: Global Postgraduate Scholarship
University of Lincoln.note: Automatic for students who meet the entry requirements of a taught master's.

University of Lincoln.name: Advance Full Payment Discount
University of Lincoln.note: Pay the year's fees in full (minus scholarships) by the deadline for your country.

Solent University.name: PGT International Excellence Scholarship
Solent University.note: Automatic for international students with a 2:1 equivalent bachelor's or master's on a full-time master's of 12+ months.

University of Salford.name: Global Gold Excellence Scholarship
University of Salford.note: First-class degree (or equivalent); assessed automatically when you apply. Pay your deposit by the deadline to keep it.

University of Salford.name: Global Silver Excellence Scholarship
University of Salford.note: At least a 2:2 (or equivalent); assessed automatically when you apply. Pay your deposit by the deadline to keep it.

University of Northampton.name: International Scholarship
University of Northampton.note: Merit-based, considered automatically from your application; the amount depends on your academic record (told in your offer letter). Pay £7,000 before CAS to accept.

University of Suffolk.name: International Merit Scholarship
University of Suffolk.note: Automatic for international students who meet or exceed the entry requirements; the amount depends on your grades.

Buckinghamshire New University.name: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship
Buckinghamshire New University.note: Self-funded international students on a full-time postgraduate degree, first year.

Buckinghamshire New University.name: International Early Payment Discount
Buckinghamshire New University.note: For paying fees in full early.

University of Brighton.name: Vice-Chancellor International Scholarship
University of Brighton.note: Automatically applied to eligible international students; can combine with some other Brighton awards (up to £3,500–£5,000 in total at postgraduate level).

Liverpool John Moores Univ..name: International Scholarship
Liverpool John Moores Univ..note: Self-funded international students; considered automatically and confirmed in your unconditional offer. Courses with fees under £17,250 aren't eligible.

Liverpool John Moores Univ..name: Early Payment Discount
Liverpool John Moores Univ..note: All self-funded international students who pay early.

Goldsmiths, Univ. of London.name: International Early Bird Discount
Goldsmiths, Univ. of London.note: Pay the £4,000 minimum deposit by the early-bird date (15 May for September 2026 entry).

Queen's University Belfast.name: South Asia Postgraduate Scholarship
Queen's University Belfast.note: For new students from South Asia on full-time taught master's; check the terms for how it is awarded.

Queen's University Belfast.name: Early Confirmation / full payment discount
Queen's University Belfast.note: Unconditional offer holders who pay tuition in full by the deadline (18 Sep 2026 for taught master's).

University for the Creative Arts.name: Full payment discount
University for the Creative Arts.note: Non-EU international students who pay full tuition (after scholarships) before or at CAS issue.

University of Surrey.name: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship
University of Surrey.note: Competitive award for selected postgraduates with academic excellence (listed for Nepalese students; apply by 20 Aug 2027).

University of Surrey.name: International Excellence Award
University of Surrey.note: Self-funded international students; apply before your CAS is issued.

Brunel University of London.name: VC's Postgraduate International Excellence Award
Brunel University of London.note: Competitive; Brunel gives the single highest award you're eligible for.

Newcastle University.name: Vice-Chancellor's Excellence Scholarship (PG)
Newcastle University.note: 30 awards for outstanding international applicants to full-time master's (listed on Newcastle's Nepal page).

University of Bath.name: Bath Global Excellence Scholarship
University of Bath.note: Up to 250 competitive awards for high achievers on full-time taught master's (Engineering & Design, Humanities & Social Sciences, Science). Deadlines 4 Feb, 8 Apr, 11 Jun 2027.

University of Portsmouth.name: Chancellor's Global Academic Merit Scholarship
University of Portsmouth.note: Merit-based; self-funded international students must complete the scholarship form with their application (January 2027 entry).

University of Lancashire (UCLan).name: Articulation Scholarship
University of Lancashire (UCLan).note: Automatic only if your bachelor's is from one of UCLan's partner institutions in Nepal (see their list).
